players.product: release film for multilayer ceramic capacitors (MLCC)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (year ended March 31, 2026; annual securities report): net sales JPY 421,563 million (-0.1%), operating profit JPY 27,906 million (+67.6%), ordinary profit JPY 22.9 billion (+116.0%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 11,174 million (+457.8%). Management states that LCD polarizer protective film COSMOSHINE SRF and release film for ceramic capacitors were firm and that packaging-film earnings improved as productivity of new equipment improved. Net sales fell short of the initial plan (JPY 440 billion) on weak diagnostic-reagent sales and the consolidation of the airbag-fabric business in Thailand, while operating profit beat the initial plan (JPY 21.0 billion), helped by higher sales of release film for ceramic capacitors and firm LCD polarizer protective film. No single customer accounted for 10% or more of net sales.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 net sales JPY 421,563 million (-0.1%); operating profit JPY 27,906 million (+67.6%)

quarterly_data.signal: Films segment, FY2026 (annual securities report): in industrial films, sales of release film for ceramic capacitors (MLCC) expanded steadily, mainly for AI servers, and LCD polarizer protective film COSMOSHINE SRF stayed firm on strong demand; segment sales JPY 175,169 million (+5.0%), segment profit JPY 16,638 million (+140.4%); Films production JPY 180,550 million (+7.3%). The company's initial FY2026 assumption of expanding demand for ceramic-capacitor release film, mainly for AI servers, held with no major deviation.
quarterly_data.figure: Films segment sales JPY 175,169 million (+5.0%), segment profit JPY 16,638 million (+140.4%)

quarterly_data.signal: 2030 Medium-Term Management Plan (company fiscal 2026-2030, i.e. FY2027-FY2031, years ending March; annual securities report): targets for FY2031 (the company's fiscal 2030) of net sales JPY 500 billion, operating profit JPY 45.0 billion, operating margin 9.0%, EBITDA JPY 76.2 billion, profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 19.0 billion, ROE above 8.0% and ROIC above 6.0% (FY2026 actual: net sales JPY 421.6 billion, operating profit JPY 27.9 billion, margin 6.6%). The company plans to raise the share of priority businesses in the capital employed by its main businesses from 27% in FY2026 to over 50% in FY2029 (company fiscal 2028); the plan does not reflect the impact of the tense Middle East situation.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2031 (company fiscal 2030) targets: net sales JPY 500 billion, operating profit JPY 45.0 billion, operating margin 9.0%

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 capex and R&D (annual securities report): capital expenditure totalled JPY 29.0 billion (including intangibles), of which the Films segment JPY 10.1 billion, led by expansion of the company's film production equipment (JPY 8.7 billion); the company states it has no significant plans for new facilities or retirements as of fiscal year-end. R&D expenses totalled JPY 14.1 billion (Films JPY 4.3 billion). For its ceramic-capacitor release film COSMOPEEL, used in growing electronics / telecommunications and automotive applications, the company is focusing on thinner layers to reduce material use and on recycling; it has started studying a COSMOSHINE SRF output increase by modifying existing equipment; corporate research developed a low-thermal-expansion polyimide expected to find use in semiconductor package substrate materials.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 capex JPY 29.0 billion (Films JPY 10.1 billion); R&D JPY 14.1 billion
